QuestInfo.name: Chief Stan's Past
QuestInfo.0: #p205# of #m10001000# seems to know a way for #p202# to regain his vitality.
QuestInfo.1: #p205# of #m10001000# mentioned that #p202# was an adventurer who traveled the world in the past, and suggested that if he could find the #b#t4031116##k lost long ago when he was young, he might regain his energy. I should inform #b#p203##k of this information. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I passed on #p205#'s advice to #p203# of #m10001000#.

0.0: I participated in the town festival as well, so I know very well. #p202# looked especially drained of energy. Hmm... How can he regain his vitality again...?
0.1: Of course! A while ago, while looking through documents related to #m10001000#, I found out that #p202# was an adventurer who traveled all across Victoria Island in his youth. However, back then, while exploring deep inside the Ant Tunnel, he reached a cave teeming with #o23#, and it is said that #bhe lost his cherished weapon#k while escaping that place. Perhaps that became the reason why he quit being an adventurer.
0.2: By any chance... how about going back there and looking for his weapon? If we could just find that, #p202# might recall old memories and regain his vitality. Of course, so many years have passed that it might be impossible to find now, but wouldn't it be better than trying nothing at all?

yes.0: I don't know if this information will be helpful to #p203#. But I think this is as far as I can go.

1.0: You're back! What did #p205# say? What? #p202# was an adventurer in his youth? That's news to me as well.

npc.0: #p202# seems to have been an adventurer who traveled all across Victoria Island in his youth. If we could only find the weapon he lost long ago, wouldn't he be able to regain his vitality as well?
